alcohol__alprostadil: Accepted claim is about ethanol or propylene glycol as an ingredient of co-administered medicines in young children, not about drinking alcohol.
adapalene__alcohol: Card is about high-alcohol topical products used on the skin with adapalene gel, not about drinking alcohol.
bromfenac__dalteparin: Bromfenac is an eye drop; the dalteparin boxed warning concerns systemically used NSAIDs during neuraxial procedures.
bromfenac__celecoxib: Bromfenac is an eye drop; the celecoxib statement concerns other NSAIDs used systemically.
